description: This file defines utility functions for generating JSON-formatted tool results, handling unknown actions, and reporting execution errors, typically used in a larger application for error handling and data formatting.

methods.name: export function jsonToolResult(data: unknown) { jsonToolResult
methods.description: Serializes data into a JSON structure suitable for tool result reporting, wrapping it with content and details.

methods.name: export function unknownToolActionResult(action: unknown) { unknownToolActionResult
methods.description: Creates a tool result indicating an unknown action with an error message.

methods.name: export function toolExecutionErrorResult(error: unknown) { toolExecutionErrorResult
methods.description: Creates a tool result reporting an execution error, extracting the error message if available.

ctags.name: text
ctags.pattern: /^    content: [{ type: "text" as const, text: JSON.stringify(data, null, 2) }],$/
